**Description**
 Join us as a Software Development Engineer on the AI Studios Engineering org within Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, where you'll build intelligent systems at the intersection of AI and cinematic storytelling. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to Creative Studio, our AI\-native content creation platform that empowers creators to produce professional animation and live action content featuring world\-class intellectual properties at unprecedented speed and scale.
   

  

 We are looking for an engineer with real depth in browser\-side application development. Creative Studio's primary surface is an interactive canvas where artists compose scenes and shots, wire up multi\-step generation workflows, and review media, often with several people working in the same project at the same time. Keeping that interface fast and correct as projects grow is one of the harder problems on the team, and it is a large part of this role.
   

  

 In this role, you'll develop production\-quality code for AI\-powered creative tools alongside experienced engineers and scientists. You'll work with creative professionals (animators, filmmakers, and storytellers) and implement features that directly transform how animation and live action/VFX content is made for Prime Video's most ambitious productions. This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who care about interface craft and performance and want to apply it to AI/ML in entertainment, on products that ship to Prime Video audiences.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, develop, and maintain software components for our AI\-native content creation platform, supporting professional animation and live\-action/VFX workflows
   

  

 Implement features across the stack, from backend services, media processing pipelines, and APIs to ML model integrations and creator\-facing tooling, with guidance from senior engineers
   

  

 Write clean, well\-tested, and maintainable code while participating in code reviews to give and receive constructive feedback
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including ML scientists, applied scientists, product managers, and creative professionals to understand requirements and deliver solutions
   

  

 Contribute to integrations with industry\-standard Digital Content Creation (DCC) tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Maya, and Storyboard Pro
   

  

 Troubleshoot and debug issues in production systems, contributing to operational excellence and system reliability
   

  

 Participate in on\-call rotations and contribute to improving system monitoring, alerting, and documentation
   

  

 Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies relevant to AI/ML systems, media processing, and distributed computing
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As an SDE on the AI Studios team, you'll spend most of your time writing and reviewing code, with regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates on design discussions. A typical day might include building a new widget for the creative canvas, adding an API endpoint behind a creator\-facing feature, implementing part of our live action VFX pipeline, or debugging an integration with our proprietary AI models. What makes this role unique is the opportunity to work on\-site alongside VFX artists and creative professionals, sitting with them as they use your tools, watching where workflows break down, and iterating rapidly to meet the demands of production timelines. You'll participate in team standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives, and you'll own a feature area end to end as you build your understanding of our systems.

 We're part of the Engineering org within newly established Prime Video's AI Studios Division, pioneering AI\-native cinematic content creation.
